jp: ヤマト「あっ、本読んでる‥‥」
en: Yamato: Oh, he's reading a book...

jp: トウヤ「集中してるみてぇーだな」
en: Touya: Looks like he's really into it.

jp: ヤマト「邪魔しちゃ悪いわね」
en: Yamato: It'd be rude to bother him.

en: Touya: Right. I don't really need anything anyway. Let's go somewhere else.

jp: ヤマト「まだ、本読んでる‥‥{nl}　やめとかニャい？」
